name: image-garden-monorepo
description: Image Garden local image embedding explorer monorepo

scripts.studio:sync: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --directory packages/studio sync --inexact --extra onnx
scripts.studio:embed: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --project packages/studio run image-garden-embed
scripts.studio:download-onnx: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --project packages/studio run image-garden-download-onnx
scripts.studio:serve: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --project packages/studio run image-garden-serve
scripts.studio:backend: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --project packages/studio run image-garden-backend
scripts.studio:app: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --project packages/studio run --extra onnx image-garden-app
scripts.studio:test: if [ -f ./.env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; unset VIRTUAL_ENV; uv --project packages/studio run python -m pytest
